card.name: Contrasting adjective after 'and'
card.fires_on: The second half of a paired contrast right after 'and' or 'the', such as general, oral, private, personal or serious. It marks the counterpart to a category just named, like special and general or local and general.

modes.label: Counterpart after 'and'
modes.description: An adjective after 'and' that pairs with an earlier opposite term.
modes.example: (local and<< general>>). - You may be asked to stop

modes.label: General vs specific group
modes.description: The word general or similar before a group noun, set against a specific group.
modes.example: CMV infection among healthcare workers appears to be no greater than that among the<< general>> public.

card.writes: It adds little clear output beyond a weak push toward words that continue a contrast.
card.plain: It spots the second word in a pair of opposites, like local and general or oral and intravenous.
